metadata.title: Ixodes Scapularis Tick Cross Section Feeding Diagram
metadata.description: A cross-section of the bite site with an enorged Ixodes tick feeding on a blood pool. Also featured is the saliva, which spreads to different regions of the bite site and has important immunomodulatory effects.
metadata.creator: Ryan Kissinger
metadata.caption: Ixodes Scapularis Tick Cross Section Feeding Diagram
